programme.desc: A doctor's much younger wife has an extra-marital affair with his friend.

programme.title: Be-Shaque
programme.desc: Prakash goes to a village to look for his friend Shyam, who is missing. However, when he sees a picture of his lover, Roopa, with a man and a child, he gets baffled and decides to investigate.

programme.title: Vaastu Shastra
programme.desc: A couple and their sister move to their new house with their young son, but soon discover that an old tree outside the house holds a strange curse which is haunting their house.

programme.title: Saazish
programme.desc: Anand travels to Mumbai in search of his missing sister, Geeta, and crosses paths with Roma, a dancer who aids him in his quest. However, he is unaware that their lives are now in grave danger.

programme.title: Sitamgar

programme.title: Dil Ka Raja
programme.desc: A wealthy man, after donating all his wealth, is humiliated by a landowner for being unable to pay dowry for his sister. So he leaves the village with his family to earn and restore his honour.

programme.title: Raampur Ka Lakshman
programme.desc: During a journey, Kedarnath Bhargav, his wife, Laxmi, and two sons, Ram and Lakshman, get separated and subsequently, they all lead different lives.

programme.title: Aradhana
programme.desc: After Arun dies in a plane crash, Vandana gives up her child for adoption as she and Arun married in secret. But, she works as a nanny for the family that adopted her son to stay close to him.

programme.title: Bairaag
programme.desc: A father abandons one of his twin sons at birth due to the baby's blindness. However, years later, a case of mistaken identity brings the brothers together again.

programme.title: Aar Paar
programme.desc: Kalu's life changes as two women fall in love with him. Afterwards, he finds himself in trouble when the father of one of them wishes for him to join a criminal gang.

programme.desc: Thakur Jagat Pratap Singh, a man from high society, falls in love with a courtesan, Jyoti, after she saves his life. However, the gulf in social status of the two prevents them from being together.

programme.title: Meri Biwi Ka Jawab Nahin
programme.desc: Durga, a village girl and the wife of Inspector Ajay, fights against the injustices that women are subjected to. She fights for the truth and encounters many obstacles in the process.

programme.title: Bol Radha Bol
programme.desc: While Kishen enjoys village life and romance with Radha, a sinister doppelgänger plots. Upon returning home, he'll discover his identity and life stolen by this malevolent impostor.

programme.title: Phool Aur Kaante
programme.desc: Love leads Ajay down a new path when he is expected to inherit his father's criminal empire, bringing along perils that could either tear their family apart or solidify their bond.

programme.title: Suhaag
programme.desc: College friends Ajay and Raj always play pranks on each other and then get into trouble. One day, Ajay needs his birth certificate for his passport, but he is shocked to find out his real name.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: In order to further strengthen their friendship, two friends marry their kin to each other. But when one of them cannot shake their illegal habits, the wedding is threatened.

programme.title: Gunda Gardi
programme.desc: Karan Singh, a police officer, is called in to help arrest Kalicharan and Narshima, two brothers who have caused problems all over the city.

programme.title: Paap
programme.desc: Kaya is a Buddhist girl who must find a young boy considered to be the reincarnation of their teacher. However, the boy witnesses a murder, which makes his return to the monastery difficult.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Yaarana
programme.desc: Childhood friends Bishan and Kishan are separated by Bishan's uncle. However, Bishan helps Kishan to become a successful singer, and Kishan uses his skills to restore Bishan's lost fortune.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss, Siddharth, is a womaniser who exploits Rahul into helping him win over Seema. However, Rahul ends up falling for Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and her.

programme.title: Khoon Bhari Maang
programme.desc: Widowed Aarti falls prey to Sanjay's vicious plan of getting married to him. Later, with the help of her best friend Nandini, he drowns Aarti and seizes her wealth, but she survives and seeks revenge.

programme.title: Gambler
programme.desc: Though Inspector Dayashanker is lazy, he unwittingly unearths a criminal conspiracy and becomes the pride of his division overnight. However, a local gangster turns his life into a nightmare.

programme.title: Pardes
programme.desc: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his NRI son; he gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter. However, she seems to share a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Arjun Singh, a police inspector, lives peacefully with his family in Mumbai, until an alarming case of harassment and murder turns his life upside down.
